mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (user_id, title, price, image_url, category, description, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, #{category}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, user_id, title, price, image_url, category, description, status, created_at FROM product ORDER BY product_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET title = #{title}, price = #{price}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, category = #{category}, description = #{description}, status = #{status} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
